opening.argument: The walkthrough directs viewers to move Bitcoin from Coinbase into BitConnect, including instructions to obtain and copy a deposit identifier for receiving Bitcoin on the platform. The speaker states, “I sent $102 to the external address of bigconnect,” then instructs viewers that “you want to buy BCC which is big connect coined.” The displayed dashboard adds lending and reinvestment controls, while stating that users will receive daily profit and capital back after the investment term. Together, these instructions promote sending Bitcoin into an investment flow and purchasing BCC alongside promised returns. The available evidence does not establish that returns were paid or that losses occurred.
